description: Phase 7A Part E audit fixture: a representative reconstruction of the reported 'superteam that only got 70-12' bug -- exact seasons chosen for the named legends where the user did not specify one (Magic 1983-84, Moses Malone 1983-84, Garnett 2008-09, Booker 2021-22 were exact; LeBron/Kobe/KD/KAT seasons were reconstructed to match the spirit of the report). Phase 7A Part F follow-up: LeBron's 2012-13 season lists PF and KD's 2013-14 season lists SF as the real per-season position -- both are curated FLEXIBLE_FORWARD_SLUGS (nba_peak.perfect_season.positions), so this SF/PF pairing is treated as real positional flexibility (never off-position, never 'Position-broken'). Expected current behavior: positional_fit ~88 (was 68 before the fix), wins in the 70-76 range, structural_weakness names the roster's actual relative soft spot (bench depth) with weakness_framing='ceiling_limiter', never a bare off-position callout of an elite player at a reasonable adjacent forward slot.
